name: HEAVEN ~ Tobenai Tori - Koi ni Itaru Yamai
original_name: HEAVEN～飛べない鳥・恋に至ル病
source:
A few years have passed. Both boys lead a happy life at the college now. On the summer vacation  Ryo decides to tutor his childhood friend. Ikuto fiercely opposes at first, but eventually gives up. This part-time job will be anything but boring.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
几年过去了。两个男孩现在在大学过着幸福的生活。暑假里，亮决定辅导他儿时的朋友。郁人一开始强烈反对，但最终还是放弃了。这份兼职工作一点也不无聊。
